scope: M motion, P protect, S system, T commit
flash_method: NOTES_MPST.md (unchanged): WCAG relative luminance, 2x2 decimated; footprint = px moving > 0.02 from frame 0; per-pixel extremum tracker logs a swing at >= 0.10; a region event = >= 25 % of the footprint swinging the same way inside 100 ms; a flash = two opposite region events; pass = <= 3 flashes in any 1 s window
loudness_method: shared gated meter (the C/D/H/L designer's fxk_lib.loud_frame, read-only snapshot): per frame, px whose CIE Lab differs by dE76 > 5 from the same frame with the effect's marks off AND from the settled frame, weighted by their L* / 100; the peak over the full-motion frames. brighter_only = px >= 5 L* above max(pre, post, marks-off), x mean L* / 100 (the M/P/S/T measure before the rebuild).

loudness_order.meter: shared gated meter: fxk_lib.loud_frame (dE76 > 5 vs the no-effect frame AND vs the settled frame, x L* / 100), peak over the full-motion frames

resolve_beat_e10.flash_method:
mp_beat_meter.py <full|red>: the 60 fps flash meter (NOTES_MPST method, unchanged) over the whole resolve beat and over every skip path.
Regions, each judged against its own footprint (px whose relative luminance moves > 0.02 from frame 0 of the run):
  whole       the whole 1920 x 1080 frame
  box:<track> each track's own box, over the WHOLE beat (neighbours and hand-offs count against it)
  tiles       240, 120 and 60 px windows on a half-size stride (a tile counts if 5 % of it moves); the worst per size is reported
Skip paths: the player skips at Ts (every 250 ms): beat frames up to Ts, the 200 ms dissolve to the settled frame, 300 ms settled;
measured from Ts - 1000 ms (the whole 1 s window before the skip counts), whole frame and the same tiles.
Per pixel: extremum tracker, swing >= 0.10; region event: >= 25 % of the footprint swung the same way within 100 ms (6 frames);
flash = two opposite region events; pass = no 1 s window holds more than 3 flashes.  -> work/beat/meter_<mode>.json

kill_colour_check.method:
beat_guard.py: review 1.8 in the resolve beat, measured on the rendered 60 fps beat frames (work/beat/full_*.npz, every 2nd px).
Round each kill token (Packet 1 at kill_p1, Worm 2 at kill: CD.TOK3['1'], CD.TOK3['2']), within 90 px, during its kill track:
px within dE76 15 of GAIN, FOCUS, lime (fxk_lib.TOKEN_GUARD) and of CELL_PINK, minus the same count on the settled beat frame
(the board's own marks), as the peak over the track's frames, in full-size px (x 4).  -> work/beat/guard.json
